name: 02130 · Jamaica Plain, MA
findings: ZIP 02130 (Jamaica Plain) has 247 nonprofit organizations. 80 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 69 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02130 (Jamaica Plain) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
